title: Purple Warrior Poses
description: Four vertical panels display the same muscular dark-skinned female warrior with short white hair in different dynamic action poses against a black background. She wears a revealing purple and silver fantasy armor outfit with leaf-like motifs and emits glowing purple energy, magical circles, and crystalline shards from her hands and body.
prompt: A powerful dark-skinned female warrior with short spiky white hair, wearing revealing purple and silver fantasy armor with leaf patterns and arm wraps, shown in four vertical panels with dynamic action poses. She channels bright purple magical energy, glowing circles, and exploding purple crystal shards from her hands and body. Cinematic lighting, dramatic black background, high detail digital fantasy art.
